_comment: Starting configs the round picks from. Every member is evaluated at round start, the ones that fail are dropped, and the best survivor becomes the search's starting config. Measured 2026-09-10: the best member beat base.json by +0.247 on an unseen round, and 20 of 64 stored configs CRASHED on that region, so the validity screen matters more than the head start.
